messages:
maya: kicking off deploy for release/checkout-ui-v2 now. change window 21:00-23:00 UTC. will do staged feature flag ramp for checkout_ui_v2_ff
simon: noted. plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100% with 10m observation between steps. manual holds at each step.
lena: ops asked to avoid big reads at 21:30-21:45, so try to keep canary -> 25% before that window.
carla: tagging release notes: "Improved checkout flow + A/B for UI v2. Opt-in via checkout_ui_v2_ff." will add rollout steps.
deploy-bot: [deploy] starting rollout of checkout-ui-v2 to dedicated pool r-inference-03. image: gh/redwood/checkout-ui:v2.1.2
ops-bot: FYI pinning model-serving version to 3.4.1 for this release to avoid runtime regressions.
simon: toggle command I'll use (internal flagctl): `flagctl set checkout_ui_v2_ff --percent=5 --note="canary start"`
maya: when you flip to 25% call out in thread and paste the flagctl output. ops will monitor errors and p95 latency.
carla: test plan: smoke checkout, cart add/remove, promo code, payment flow 3x on canary users — results due in 8m after each step.
simon: flagctl output: OK checkout_ui_v2_ff=5% (id=ff_8891)
lena: logs look clean so far, no spike in errors, p95 +8ms which is expected. ready for 25%.
simon: setting 25% now -> `flagctl set checkout_ui_v2_ff --percent=25 --note="ramp1"`
deploy-bot: [flag-change] checkout_ui_v2_ff updated: 5% -> 25% by simon at 1764507520
carla: smoke checks: payment flow passed x3 on canary users, no 500s
maya: ops, please watch downstream payment service latency for 30m after 25% tilt.
ops-bot: Scheduled check: payment-svc latency probe every 1m for 30m. alert on >2x baseline for 3 consecutive probes.
simon: after 25% holds fine for 12m, going to 75% on my mark.
maya: hold 1m for canary metrics to settle pls.
simon: flipping to 75% -> `flagctl set checkout_ui_v2_ff --percent=75 --note="ramp2"`
deploy-bot: [flag-change] checkout_ui_v2_ff updated: 25% -> 75% by simon at 1764508125
lena: seeing slight QoS increase for a small subset, p95 for variant A +25ms but error rate steady.
carla: ops, do we run full 75% for 10m or 20m?
ops-bot: Recommend 10m given traffic schedule. extending to 15m if any anomaly.
maya: agree 10m. if p95 > +50ms or error rate >0.5% rollback to previous flag state (25%) and pin rollback notes.
simon: 10m passed clean. moving to 100%.
simon: `flagctl set checkout_ui_v2_ff --percent=100 --note="full roll"`
deploy-bot: [flag-change] checkout_ui_v2_ff updated: 75% -> 100% by simon at 1764508720
lena: one downstream job failed but retried, no user impact. monitoring continues.
carla: updating release notes to GA: "Checkout UI v2 rolled out 100% behind flag checkout_ui_v2_ff. Monitored metrics: p95 latency, error rate, payment-svc latency."
maya: ops confirmed no sustained regressions. closing change window early? keep until 23:00 but we can mark as monitored.
ops-bot: Change window will remain open until 23:00 UTC. auto-close notification will be posted.
simon: adding pin: `deployctl pin service checkout-service --version=3.4.1 --reason="compat with ui v2"`
deploy-bot: [pin] checkout-service pinned to 3.4.1 by simon at 1764508850
carla: final note: if any rollback needed run: `flagctl set checkout_ui_v2_ff --percent=0 --note="rollback"` and open a rollback runbook ticket.
maya: thanks all — good coordination. I'll file a short postmortem if we see any followups. :thumbsup:
